Equilynx.name: Equilynx
Equilynx.description:
<c=254d0c>Equilynx</c>
From Elestria, it brings the power of the Earth element with it specializing in <c=boldPink>Midrow that want to be Destroyed</c> and <c=boldPink>Powerful Single Attacks</c>

FoloiForest.name: FOLOI FOREST
FoloiForest.description: The second time you launch an <c=midrow>object</c> each turn gain 1 <c=status>OVERDRIVE NEXT TURN</c>

PoisonTippedArrow.name: POISON TIPPED ARROW
PoisonTippedArrow.description: At the start of combat gain 1 <c=status>WEAKEN CHARGE</c>

PoisonedTunic.name: POISONED TUNIC
PoisonedTunic.description: Enemies take 1 extra damage when hit in a <c=parttrait>WEAK</c> or <c=parttrait>BRITTLE</c> part.

Teratlas.name: TERATLAS
Teratlas.description: At start of turn gain 1 <c=energy>ENERGY</c> if any <c=midrow>object</c> is an <c=midrow>Earth Stone</c> or a <c=midrow>Flower Stone</c>.

Dyna.name: DETONATION ASSISTANCE
Dyna.description: When you stick a <c=ptrait>charge</c>, launch a <c=midrow>Mini Earth Stone</c>.

Dizzy.name: EARTH WALL
Dizzy.description: When you destroy an <c=midrow>object</c> gain 1 <c=status>MAX SHIELD</c> and 1 <c=status>SHIELD</c>.

Riggs.name: EARTH THRUSTERS
Riggs.description: The first time you launch an <c=midrow>Earth Stone</c> each turn draw a card and gain 1 <c=status>EVADE</c>.

Peri.name: DEMETER'S PENDANT
Peri.description: At the start of combat gain 2 <c=status>POWERDRIVE</c>. At the start of every turn gain -1 <c=status>OVERDRIVE</c>.

Isaac.name: DRONE PROTECTOR
Isaac.description: Before you launch an <c=midrow>Earth Stone</c>, <c=midrow>Flower Stone</c>, <c=midrow>Power Stone</c>, or <c=midrow>Repair Kit</c>, bubble the object in front of your missile bay if it is not an <c=midrow>Earth Stone</c>, <c=midrow>Power Stone</c>, or <c=midrow>Repair Kit</c>.

Drake.name: HEAT-ABSORBING STONES
Drake.description: The second time you launch an <c=midrow>object</c> each turn lose 2 <c=status>HEAT</c>.

Max.name: TCG RULEBOOK
Max.description: All cards get <c=cardtrait>retain</c>. At the start of your turn you only draw 1 card, if you have less than 5 cards in hand draw till you have 5 cards instead.

Books.name: SPIRIT CRYSTALIZATION
Books.description: When you launch an <c=object>Earth Stone</c> gain 1 <c=status>SHARD</c>.

CAT.name: CASTING.EXE
CAT.description: Gain an <c=card>Equilynx.EXE</c>. When you play a <c=cardtrait>temp</c> <c=254d0c>Equilynx</c> card, discount it.

Angder.name: EMPOWERED RAMPAGE
Angder.description: While <c=3A4999>Angder</c> is missing, when the midrow shifts the enemy takes 1 hull damage.

D26.name: LEAKING STONES
D26.description: Add a <c=cardtrait>temp</c>, <c=card>Nexus Blast</c> that <c=cardtrait>exhausts</c> to your hand at the start of every other turn.

Grunan.name: RECKLESS CASTING
Grunan.description: <c=card>Fireball</c> also gives you -1 <c=status>OVERDRIVE</c>, Add a discounted <c=card>Fireball</c> to your hand at the start of combat.

Kobrette.name: SIEGE STONES
Kobrette.description: Gain 4 <c=status>EARTH STONE DEPOSIT</c> at the start of combat. At the start of your turn gain 1 <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c>.

Randall.name: NEXUS MODIFICATION
Randall.description: At the start of combat <c=cardtrait>synergize</c> your <c=card>Nexus</c> cards. When you play a <c=card>Nexus</c> card <c=cardtrait>synergize</c> it.

Ruhig.name: DRAGON OFFERINGS
Ruhig.description: At the start of combat add a <c=cardtrait>temp</c> <c=card>Ambrosia B</c> to your hand.

Jack.name: INSTANT MISSILES
Jack.description: Add an <c=card>Instant Missile</c> to your deck.

Cleo.name: TOP-OF-THE-LINE CANNONS
Cleo.description: When you lose <c=status>overdrive</c> during your turn lose 1 less.

Destiny.name: COMPLICATED EXPLOSIVES
Destiny.description: <c=cardtrait>Explosive</c> <c=action>attacks</c> deal 4 more damage if you have <c=status>Hyper Focus. Add a <c=card>Steady Focus</c> to your deck.

Bucket.name: METICULOUS AIM
Bucket.description: At the end of your turn, if you only shot once during your turn, gain 2 <c=status>redraw</c>. If it was a 9+ damage shot gain 10 instead.

Nola.name: EFFICIENT POISON
Nola.description: When you play 5 0-cost cards in a turn, gain a <c=status>weaken charge</c>.

Isabelle.name: WICKED WALTZ
Isabelle.description: If you <c=action>launched</c>, <c=action>attacked</c>, <c=action>moved</c>, and <c=action>ruptured</c> in a turn gain 1 <c=status>overdrive next turn</c>.

Ilya.name: THERMAL FEEDBACK
Ilya.description: When you lose overdrive lose heat instead if possible.

Jost.name: BROKEN MEDAL
Jost.description: When you lose <c=status>shield</c> gain 1 <c=status>overdrive</c>. When you lose <c=status>overdrive</c> gain 1 <c=status>shield</c>.

Gauss.name: DESTRUCTION PLANS
Gauss.description: At the start of combat gain 1 <c=status>autocurrent</c>.

Sorrel.name: A DROP OF WINE
Sorrel.description: At the start of your turn gain 1 <c=status>bullet time</c> if you have none and force enemy attack.

description.None: Add 1 of {{Count}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=254d0c>Equilynx</c> cards to your hand.
description.A: Add 1 of {{Count}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=254d0c>Equilynx</c> cards to your hand.
description.B: Add 1 of {{Count}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=254d0c>Equilynx</c> cards to your hand.

AutododgeLeftNextTurn.name: Autododge Left Next Turn
AutododgeLeftNextTurn.description: At the start of next turn, gain <c=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=status>AUTODODGE LEFT</c>.

EarthStoneDeposit.name: Earth Stone Deposit
EarthStoneDeposit.description: Launch <c=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=midrow>Mini Earth Stones</c> at the end of every turn.

FlowerStoneDeposit.name: Flower Stone Deposit
FlowerStoneDeposit.description: Launch <c=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=midrow>Flower Stones</c> at the start of every turn.

OverdriveNextTurn.name: Overdrive Next Turn
OverdriveNextTurn.description: At the start of next turn, gain <c=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=status>OVERDRIVE</c>.

HyperFocus.name: Hyper Focus
HyperFocus.description: <c=downside>Each turn, only the first attack of this ship will deal damage</c>

Mini.name: Mini Earth Stone
Mini.description: When destroyed, this attacks for 1 in the same direction.

Normal.name: Earth Stone
Normal.description: When destroyed, this attacks for 2 in the same direction.

Big.name: Big Earth Stone
Big.description: When destroyed, this attacks for 3 in the same direction.

offset.description: Destroy an <c=midrow>object</c> <c=boldPink>{0}</c> spaces to the {1} of your {2}.

notOffset.description: Destroy an <c=midrow>object</c> in front of your {2}.

DroneMoveRandom.name: Move Midrow Randomly
DroneMoveRandom.description: Instantly move all <c=midrow>midrow objects</c> {0} spaces in a random direction.

In combat, <c=keyword>right click or ctrl-click</c> this card to switch between them.
controller: This card has four separate sets of actions.
In combat, press {{Button}} on this card to switch between them.
